$comment: What each package is allowed to publish, and how large it may be.
requiredFiles must be present. Every other file must match one of the anchored
allowedPatterns, so a stray file in dist (a leftover spec, a .env, a scratch
build) fails rather than shipping. The exports targets are NOT listed here:
the gate reads them from the packed manifest and checks them against the
tarball itself, which is stronger than a list that can go stale.
maxPackedBytes carries roughly a tenth of headroom over the measured size, the
same convention as tests/bundle-size. Refresh with --update after an
intentional change and commit the diff.
Sourcemaps are shipped deliberately, and they are most of these bytes.
--update refuses to raise a budget a package has already breached, so a
breach is always a deliberate edit. @domternal/theme went 83000 to 95000 on
2026-08-20, measured at 86185 packed: the paper layer gained the palette
re-emission, the header-group promotion, the image clamp and the reservation
hook, and _content.scss gained the list marker cycle.
2026-09-19: typed i18n catalogs, locale services and retained live UI add
production code, declarations and deliberate source maps. Measured packed
bytes: core 800641, image 66930, math 36005, mention 47305, table 128044,
toc 96777. Their ceilings now follow the documented ten percent headroom
rounded up to 1000 bytes. File allowlists and export checks are unchanged.
2026-09-20: optional German subpaths add their own runtime files, declarations
and source maps. Final packed measurements: details 43411, math 40211 bytes.
Their ceilings retain ten percent headroom rounded up to 1000 bytes.
Existing English main JS bundles are byte-identical; locale allowlists name
only de.js/de.cjs, their maps and their ESM/CommonJS declaration files.

The current maxPackedBytes includes one official locale. Each additional central locale receives only its fixed maxAdditionalLocaleBytes allowance; deleting a locale cannot increase the ceiling. Locale runtime, source map and declaration files are required by exact discovered name. No locale wildcard is allowed in tarballs. The reviewed increments allow ordinary text variation and are never derived automatically from a new language. --update keeps the reviewed base unchanged when multiple locale catalogs are present, so it cannot compound allowances or attribute their bytes to the base.

2026-09-24: the new optional paste-cleanup package initially measured 428770 packed bytes. Strict Office list reconstruction, inherited formatting and destination capability checks raise it to 510675. The reviewed 562000 ceiling covers ESM and CommonJS editor and standalone HTML entries, declarations, deliberate source maps and bundled HAST notices with about ten percent headroom. Core, ProseMirror and parse5 remain external; no runtime dependency was added for this increment. No existing package gains a dependency on this opt-in extension.

2026-09-24: integrated local clipboard image preparation, cancellation, bounded source capture and pending feedback raise the packed cleanup package to about 663000 bytes, including both module formats, declarations and intentional source maps. Reviewed source maps contain only production modules and existing HAST dependencies. The 730000 ceiling retains about ten percent headroom; allowed files and all other package ceilings remain unchanged.

2026-09-27: persistent resolver ownership, inline assets, destination probes, styled breaks and explicit list markers now measure 767675 packed bytes. The previous ceiling predates those additions. Reviewed tarball membership and every source-map entry contain only intended production modules, existing vendor dependencies and the single German catalog. Source maps account for 69.53 percent of unpacked bytes; the list-marker increment adds 49381 unpacked dist bytes over the styled-break snapshot, with declarations and locale output unchanged. The reviewed 845000 ceiling follows the existing ten percent headroom convention. File allowlists, the fixed additional-locale allowance and all JavaScript entry budgets remain unchanged.

2026-09-27: unknown list marker normalization, the contentDiagnostic event, the normalizeListMarkers migration command and the attribute refusals add production code, declarations and deliberate source maps to core. Measured packed bytes: core 882211, up from 864096 at the previous commit. The 971000 ceiling follows the documented ten percent headroom rounded up to 1000 bytes. File allowlists and export checks are unchanged.

2026-09-28: own-copy recognition with the same-page copy marker, the quiet Office envelope classification, the bounded Word @list level reader, Word list profile reconstruction from level definitions and marker run fonts, and the per item Office list fallback raise the packed cleanup package to 861052 bytes, including both module formats, declarations and intentional source maps. No dependency was added. The 948000 ceiling keeps the documented ten percent headroom rounded up to 1000 bytes; file allowlists and all other package ceilings are unchanged.

2026-09-28: the experimental @domternal/core/clipboard subpath adds dist/clipboard.js, dist/clipboard.cjs, their empty source maps and self-contained dist/clipboard.d.ts and .d.cts. The code files only re-export the sibling main bundle, so no module is shipped twice. Core now measures 888702 packed bytes, up from 887629, including the README section and the experimental markers in the declarations; the ceiling is unchanged. The core allowlist names only the index and clipboard files.

2026-09-29: the Markdown URL policy (link and image address checks through core, a refused link written as its text, escaped destinations and one-line titles) and its README section raise the packed markdown package from 83895 to 90150 bytes, including both module formats, declarations and intentional source maps. No dependency was added. The previous 85000 ceiling kept about one percent headroom; the new 100000 ceiling follows the documented ten percent headroom rounded up to 1000 bytes. File allowlists and all other package ceilings are unchanged.
